<thought>We need a retrosynthetic template that corresponds to a Friedel‑Crafts acylation (electrophilic aromatic substitution) where a halide is lost in the forward direction. The target molecule is provided in the previous step as a SMILES string. By searching the template catalog for entries that break a halide functional group we can retrieve candidate templates; the first suitable one will give us the required mapped reaction SMILES and its template_id.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1ccc(CNc2c(C(=O)Nc3cccc(OC)c3)nnn2Cc2ccc(CN3CC(F)C3)cc2)cc1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
